transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've had sinus congestion and drainage for the last several days. It's been bothering me enough that I thought I should come in and get it checked.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
No, I haven't had any bad reactions to medicines that I know of.
Can you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken in the last few days?
I don't take any medicines regularly that I can think of. I was just diagnosed with diabetes last fall, but I'm not aware of being on any routine medication for it.
Have you had any other symptoms along with the sinus congestion and drainage?
No, nothing else really. I haven't had any stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, or constipation, and no blood in my urine or stools. I feel well overall otherwise.
Where do you feel the congestion and drainage?
It's in my sinuses — mostly around my nose and cheeks. The drainage runs down the back of my throat.
Is there anything that seems to make your sinus congestion and drainage better?
No, I haven't noticed anything that makes it better. It's just been there for the last several days.
Besides your diabetes, is there anything else in your past health or medical history you’d like to add?
I'm a non-smoker. My mammogram is up to date and I see my gynaecologist regularly, and I check my feet regularly too. That's really about it.
What worries you most about your sinus congestion and drainage?
I wouldn't say I'm terribly worried — it's just been hanging on for several days and not clearing up, so I wanted to get it looked at.
How much are the sinus congestion and drainage affecting your day-to-day life right now?

Honestly, not much. I feel well overall and I still walk 1 to 2 miles most days — at the local mall when the weather's bad. The congestion is annoying but it's not keeping me from doing what I normally do.
How would you describe what the congestion and drainage feel like to you?
It feels like a stuffy, full pressure around my nose and cheeks, and there's a dripping sensation at the back of my throat. Nothing sharp or painful — just congested and draining.
Is there anything else you take for your health — even something you only use now and then, or started recently?
No, nothing at all. I don't take anything for my health, not even now and then, and I haven't started anything recently.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
